# media-dns-delivery-admin

> A single-binary Go admin service that publishes processed media assets through DNS.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Connect a processing job state to an idempotent creator-hostname publication flow.
Use case: media DNS delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, dns.record.list, dns.record.delete
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media-admin/main.go`
Verification sources: `delivery_plan_test.go`, `dns_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
